quick_start.input_format: Foreground machinery establishes the baseline space. + One adult approaches through the established depth layers. + The hand reaches a visible functional control. + The alarm state follows that action. + The low reverse angle reveals the same person and a concrete result.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish one suspended archive scanner and hanging cable loops in a dim cyan records lab with no clear person. Let the conservator crouch and reach the document cradle while cable loops preserve depth. Reverse low beneath the scanner as the same conservator pulls back and a sealed page lifts inside the cradle.
